name: Diffusion-regularized NeRF
aliases: Diffusion-based Regularization for Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A method that regularizes Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) by using a denoising diffusion model (DDM) trained on RGBD patches to predict the gradient of the logarithm of the joint probability distribution of color and depth, which is backpropagated to the NeRF's color and density fields during training.
